entries.en: I met up with Ohya[n]at the aquarium...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: When you said Shinagawa, I was[n]wondering what you had in mind.[n]But an aquarium, huh...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Not exactly my go-to spot, but...[n]It's pretty nice.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: They actually had me write up an[n]article on date spots in the city, back[n]in the day.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I remember wondering what was so[n]great about staring at a load of fish.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Now I think I get it.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: It's like... When you're with your[n]true love, any date is a great date![n]Or something cheesy like that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...By the way, is this a date for White[n]Day?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Whaaat? That's so sweet!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Still, I kind of figured you had some[n]plan in the works... maybe.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...By the way. This is definitely a date[n]for White Day, right?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Man, thank god!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, since we didn't get to have our[n]Valentine's Day, let's live it up[n]tonight!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...By the way. This is definitely a date[n]for White Day, right?
Of course.
Yes.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I get it. So this is an apology for your[n]little scandal.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Okay. I guess I can forgive you!
...Ohya seems pleased.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, I think that's the last exhibit.[n]Time to get wasted!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, except you. You're sticking to juice.[n]Anywhere you want to go eat?
I have a reservation set.
I have a place in mind.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Yeah, we should totally—wait, what?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You, uh... Really?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hee hee... Then I guess you're leading[n]the charge today.
